stem:
Find out the major product from the following reaction

3-methylcyclohex-2-en-1-one $\xrightarrow[\text{2) } n\text{-PrI}]{\text{1) MeMgBr/CuI}}$
solution: $\text{CH}_3\text{MgBr}$/CuI adds 1,4 (conjugate addition) to give the enolate, which is alkylated at the $\alpha$-carbon by n-PrI: 3,3-dimethyl-2-propylcyclohexanone.
notes: Reactant and options are skeletal structures in the source; transcribed as names (option C approximated).

Which type of isomerism is shown by 2, 3-dichlorobutane?

2-Bromophenol $\xrightarrow{(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CLi}}$ (A) $\xrightarrow[\text{(ii) H}_3\text{O}^+]{\text{(i) CO}_2}$ salicylic acid

In the given conversion the compound A is :
solution: $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CLi}$ acts as a base (deprotonating –OH) and also does halogen–lithium exchange, giving A with –Li on the ring and –OLi. Carboxylation with $\text{CO}_2$ and acidification give salicylic acid.
notes: Structures in source; transcribed as names.

The absolute configuration of the following Fischer projection is:

$\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ (top); C2: H (left), OH (right); C3: H (left), Cl (right); $\text{CH}_3$ (bottom)
solution: Assigning CIP priorities at C2 (OH > COOH > CHCl > H) gives S; at C3 (Cl > CH(OH) > CH$_3$ > H) gives R. So (2S, 3R).
